sydney-blue-mountains-and-bells-line.title: Sydney · Blue Mountains and Bells Line
sydney-blue-mountains-and-bells-line.slogan: A 301 km loop out of Bells Line of Road
sydney-blue-mountains-and-bells-line.story: Escarpments, cool air and proper overlook stops. 301 km round from Kurrajong Heights - plan on about 5 h 47 of riding. It goes by way of Mount Victoria and Three Sisters lookout. Oberon high country is the high point. It tops out at about 1,050 m. The passes are the reason to go.

places-centelles-abric-ii-recodo-de-los-.story: 251 km from Catí to Catí, about 4 h 20 of riding. On the way it passes Abrigo del Arenal de la fonseca ó Abrigo d, Recodo de los Chaparros II and back through Abrigo del Arenal de la fonseca ó Abrigo d. The highest point is about 1,350 m. The line favours views over speed.

legend-montenegro-durmitor-ring.story: curated scenic road. limestone peaks, canyons, high plateau. 65 km from Žabljak to Žabljak, about 1 h 11 of riding. The highest point is about 1,900 m. Sedlo Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 10 km this is Montenegro Durmitor Ring, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
